tools.name: list-endpoints
tools.description: Lists all API paths and their HTTP methods with summaries, organized by path. Results can be passed directly into 'get-endpoint'.

tools.name: get-endpoint
tools.description: Gets detailed information about a specific API endpoint, including security schemes and servers

tools.name: search-endpoints
tools.description: Performs a deep search through paths, operations, and parameters to discover relevant API endpoints. Use this tool to find specific API capabilities, required parameters, or data models based on search keywords. Results can be passed directly into 'get-endpoint'.

tools.name: get-server-variables
tools.description: Gets the server variables for each server within a specific OpenAPI spec.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches through documentation with the given search query, returning a list of results with ID, title, and URL.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Gets detailed content for documentation by ID returned from the `search` tool.

tools.name: list-webhook-events
tools.description: Call this when the user asks about Branch webhooks, events, notifications, or callbacks — including which events exist, what data an event contains, or which event fires at a given point in worker onboarding or payment. Returns the complete catalog of all 22 Branch webhook events with their payload

tools.name: branch-overview
tools.description: Call this when the user is new to Branch or is asking what Branch is, what it does, how its core objects relate (organizations, workers, wallets, payment profiles, disbursements), or where to begin an integration. Returns a one-page orientation: the object model, the worker lifecycle from onboarding

tools.name: disbursements-integration
tools.description: Call this when the user is building, planning, or reviewing a Branch Disbursements integration, where the partner pays workers through Branch Wallet or Branch Direct. This includes Disbursements with Tax Filing, Co-Branded Card, or Whitelabel. Returns the required step-by-step integration path: Crea

tools.name: audit-integration
tools.description: Call this when the user asks to review, audit, check, or validate Branch integration code, or a pull request that touches Branch API calls, webhook handlers, onboarding flows, or payouts. Returns Branch's audit checklist: critical violations, warnings, and passing checks for each standard solution,

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, list-webhook-events, audit-integration · Private data: disbursements-integration · Public sink: list-webhook-events, disbursements-integration, audit-integration · Destructive: audit-integration.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, list-webhook-events, audit-integration · Private data: disbursements-integration · Public sink: list-webhook-events, disbursements-integration, audit-integration · Destructive: audit-integration

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "branch-overview" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
